en.html:
She led me to a temple neither especially famous nor especially grand. Still one of the venerable temples Kamakura took pride in, certainly.

Not a worshipper. Not even a monk in sight. Surely somebody lived here... though if told otherwise, I might have believed that also. Such a deserted look it had.

Nearby stood Kenchouji, first of the Kamakura Five Mountains; Engakuji, second; and Jouchiji, fourth. Distinguished neighbors in every direction. Perhaps that explained it. Even on ordinary days, this temple seemed to receive little traffic.
